title: Paginated API
hints: Two nested loops: an outer one over page numbers (`for page := 1; ; page++`) and an inner `for _, item := range items`. The outer loop ends on an error or when `more` is `false`.

Inside the outer loop: call `fetch(page)`; on `err != nil` yield `(zero, err)` and `return`; yield every item with `nil` (return if `yield` says stop); then `if !more { return }`. `CollectAll` is a range loop that returns early on the first non-nil `err`.
